feature-disabled.stateText: Product Strategy is not enabled yet.The capability is off, so no request was sent.FEATURE_DISABLED

not-authorized.stateText: This account cannot read the site list.A server answered with a sign-in or access page rather than the list. Asking again will not change that.NOT_AUTHORIZED

timeout.stateText: The database did not answer in time.The request for the site list reached the server and no answer came back within the time it was given. Nothing was changed; asking again is safe.SOURCE_TIMED_OUT

non-json.stateText: The address answered, but not with a site list.Something returned a web page where the API was expected, so no site menu was built from it.RESPONSE_NOT_READABLE

source-unavailable.stateText: Not connected to the Operation System database.No server answered. Nothing is shown in place of the list that was not read.SOURCE_NOT_CONNECTED

awaiting-site.stateText: Choose a site to analyse.This board reads one site at a time — a company, a country and a marketplace — because prices from two sites on one axis would compare products that do not compete.

empty-site.stateText: No products are listed for this scope.The source was read and this site has nothing in it. That is a measurement, not a failure.
